note: Oil eased back on 17 November: Brent slipped to about $92.61/bbl and WTI to about $85.73/bbl (Reuters, 09:10 GMT), while TTF fell to about €84.18/MWh and JKM dropped roughly 12% to $27.58. Recovering Middle East exports and the IEA's forecast Q4 supply surplus offset a fresh tanker attack near the Strait of Hormuz on 16 November (the tanker On Phoenix, struck off Oman); ANZ analysts put Hormuz throughput at about 49% of pre-war levels. In Yemen, government-aligned forces withdrew from the Bab el-Mandeb area on 15 November, letting the Houthis retake positions overlooking the strait's southern approach.
